Physics & phone test notes

Translation, spin and height are simulated together. Contact friction decides whether the ball grips or slides. Wall and rim impacts can produce hops; free fall and rim contact decide whether a hole captures the ball.

Material profiles are fixed. Ice grip, wood losses and ball bounce use provisional contact estimates. Billiards coefficients are literature reference values, not a calibrated replica. Air drag acts on every ball. Sand uses a density-dependent sinkage and resistance approximation, not individual grains. The model is literature-informed and awaits physical calibration.

Read the equations, parameter values and sources

Test a pitched calibration, rotation, a quick tilt step and app switching on iPhone Safari and Android Chrome. Browser timestamps do not measure full physical motion-to-pixel latency.
